title: text set

messages.description: a message to add or replace
message number to replace, or to add if past the end
element to start replacing at, negative replaces the whole message
pointer to the text if -s flag is used

arguments.description: text name if no flags are given

flags.name: -s <symbol, symbol>
flags.description: struct name and field name of main structure

body: [text set] replaces a line of a text, or adds one when the line number is past the end. With an element number, it replaces only part of the line, starting at that element. The text is named by the argument or the right inlet, or found through a pointer with -s.
